title: Ash Hunger
text: Healing feeds a furnace that never remembers being full.
origin: Unbound ash settled in the wounds and learned the shape of appetite.
adaptationText: Once per round, defeating an elite while carrying at least two Wounds grants 1 Salvage if that battle awarded none.
trigger: Healing service or elite victory while wounded.

effect.text: Ash Hunger demanded a richer recovery.

relief: Purge this Scar at the Sable Machine Choir.
upside: A qualifying elite victory can grant 1 Salvage.
